name: Native gold
definition: native gold sold as a mineral specimen (nugget, crystal or wire, on or off matrix); a refined bar, round or coin sold by weight is F3.

name: Pyrite
definition: iron sulfide mineral specimen (cubes, clusters, suns, on or off matrix).

name: Fluorite
definition: calcium fluoride mineral specimen (crystals, clusters, octahedra, specimens on matrix, polished pieces).

name: Quartz
definition: uncut quartz specimen that no separate quartz kind covers (rock crystal points and clusters, tumbled and polished quartz).

name: Amethyst
definition: uncut purple quartz specimen (geode, point, cluster, tumbled stone, slab, sphere); a faceted or cabochon amethyst is F6.5.2.05.

name: Agate
definition: uncut or polished banded chalcedony specimen (nodule, geode, slab, tumbled stone).

name: Jasper
definition: uncut or polished opaque microcrystalline quartz specimen (rough, tumbled stone, slab, sphere); a cut cabochon of jasper falls under the F-4 test into F6.5 when attested.

name: Opal
definition: opal specimen, matrix piece or uncut nodule; a loose opal cut en cabochon or faceted, or opal rough sold as cutting material, is F6.5.2.10.

name: Corundum
definition: uncut corundum specimen, including ruby and sapphire crystals on or off matrix; cut stones and cutting rough are F6.5.2.01 and F6.5.2.02.

name: Calcite
definition: calcium carbonate mineral specimen (crystals, clusters, specimens on matrix).

name: Malachite
definition: copper carbonate mineral specimen (botryoidal or banded rough, polished pieces, slabs).

name: Barite
definition: barium sulfate mineral specimen (bladed crystals, clusters, roses); level provisional (CV-27).

name: Tourmaline
definition: uncut tourmaline specimen (crystals, clusters, on or off matrix); facet-grade rough sold by weight and cut stones are F6.5.2.07.

name: Garnet
definition: uncut garnet-group specimen (crystals on or off matrix, tumbled stones); cut stones and cutting rough are F6.5.2.06.

name: Granite
definition: coarse-grained intrusive igneous rock sample.

name: Basalt
definition: fine-grained extrusive igneous rock sample.

name: Obsidian
definition: natural volcanic glass sample.

name: Sandstone
definition: sedimentary rock sample of cemented sand grains.

name: Marble
definition: metamorphic rock sample of recrystallised carbonate.

name: Slate
definition: fine-grained foliated metamorphic rock sample.

name: Rock and mineral teaching set
definition: kit of unlike labelled specimens (rocks across classes, and minerals or fossils) sold, standardised and compared as one object, usually for teaching (S3a, K-1); a mixed set not sold as a teaching kit is filed by its item of greatest value.

name: Ammonite
definition: fossil ammonoid shell, whole, split, polished or on matrix, including unworked stones kept for a religious tradition (F-17).

name: Trilobite
definition: fossil trilobite, prepared on or off matrix.

name: Belemnite
definition: fossil belemnite guard or other straight cephalopod.

name: Echinoderm fossil
definition: fossil echinoderm (crinoid, starfish, sea urchin, blastoid).

name: Ammolite
definition: gem-quality iridescent ammonite shell material, rough or cut (F-4).

name: Fossil shark tooth
definition: fossil tooth of a shark or ray.

name: Dinosaur fossil
definition: fossil tooth, bone or claw of a dinosaur (`part` attribute).

name: Fossil fish
definition: fossil fish, whole or partial, usually on matrix.

name: Petrified wood
definition: fossil wood replaced by silica or other minerals, rough, slab or polished.

name: Stromatolite
definition: layered fossil structure built by microbial mats, rough or polished.

name: Amber
definition: fossilised tree resin, raw, polished or cut, with or without inclusions (the inclusion's taxon is a tag).

name: Copal
definition: young, partly fossilised tree resin, sold beside amber.

name: Iron meteorite
definition: meteorite made mainly of iron-nickel metal.

name: Pallasite
definition: stony-iron meteorite of olivine crystals in iron-nickel metal.

name: Carbonaceous chondrite
definition: chondrite rich in carbon compounds and water-bearing minerals.

name: Ordinary chondrite
definition: the common stony meteorite of chondrules (H, L, LL groups).

name: Lunar meteorite
definition: achondrite meteorite ejected from the Moon.

name: Martian meteorite
definition: achondrite meteorite ejected from Mars.

name: Tektite and impactite
definition: natural glass or rock formed by a meteorite impact (tektites, impact glass, impactites).

name: Diamond
definition: loose cut diamond, or diamond cutting rough, graded on the colourless-to-light-colour scale.

name: Fancy-colour diamond
definition: loose diamond of natural fancy colour, graded on the separate coloured-diamond scale (F-23).

name: Sapphire
definition: loose cut corundum of any colour but red, or sapphire cutting rough.

name: Ruby
definition: loose cut red corundum, or ruby cutting rough; level provisional (CV-27).

name: Emerald
definition: loose cut green beryl, or emerald cutting rough.

name: Spinel
definition: loose cut spinel, or spinel cutting rough; level provisional (CV-27).

name: Amethyst (cut)
definition: loose faceted or cabochon amethyst, or amethyst cutting rough; shares `species_id` with F6.1.4.02.

name: Garnet (cut)
definition: loose faceted or cabochon garnet of any species, or garnet cutting rough; shares `species_id` with F6.1.9.02.

name: Tourmaline (cut)
definition: loose faceted or cabochon tourmaline, or facet-grade tourmaline rough sold by weight; shares `species_id` with F6.1.9.01.

name: Topaz
definition: loose cut topaz, or topaz cutting rough.

name: Tanzanite
definition: loose cut blue-violet zoisite, or tanzanite cutting rough.

name: Opal (cut)
definition: loose opal cut en cabochon or faceted, or opal rough sold as cutting material; an opal specimen, matrix piece or uncut nodule is F6.1.4.05 (section 14; provisional until a page shows cut opal sold).

name: Saltwater pearl
definition: loose undrilled pearl grown in a saltwater mollusc, natural or cultured.

name: Freshwater pearl
definition: loose undrilled pearl grown in a freshwater mussel, natural or cultured.

name: Cowrie
definition: shell of a cowrie (Cypraeidae).

name: Cone shell
definition: shell of a cone snail (Conidae).

name: Scallop shell
definition: shell or valve of a scallop (Pectinidae).

name: Coral skeleton
definition: dead, dried skeleton of a coral (living coral is out under step 1; fossil coral is F6.3).

name: Sea urchin test
definition: dried, emptied shell (test) of a sea urchin.

name: Taxidermy bird mount
definition: bird skin preserved and mounted as in life.

name: Taxidermy mammal mount
definition: mammal skin preserved and mounted as in life (full mount, shoulder or head mount).

name: Mammal skull
definition: cleaned real skull of a mammal kept as a specimen.

name: Tusk specimen
definition: real tusk or tusk section kept as a specimen (ivory regimes in the C17 ledger).

name: Egg or nest specimen
definition: blown or emptied egg shell, or a dried nest, kept as a specimen (an egg for hatching is out under step 1).

name: Antler or horn
definition: real antler or horn kept as a specimen (an antler chew for dogs is B10).

name: Fish jaw or tooth set
definition: dried jaw or set of teeth of a fish or shark kept as a specimen.

name: Pinned butterfly or moth
definition: dried, pinned or spread lepidopteran specimen, framed or unframed (a frame fixed to the one specimen is part of the object).

name: Feather specimen
definition: feather kept and labelled as a specimen (craft feathers are C4).

name: Herbarium sheet
definition: pressed, dried plant mounted on a sheet as a specimen (dried flowers for decor are B4).

name: Insect in resin
definition: real insect or small animal specimen embedded in a clear resin block.

name: Fluid-preserved specimen
definition: wet specimen of an animal or other organism kept in preserving fluid in a jar; the animal group is an attribute.

name: Element ampoule
definition: sample of a chemical element sealed in a glass ampoule.

name: Element cube
definition: sample of a chemical element machined or cast as a cube of standard size.

name: Encased element sample
definition: sample of a chemical element embedded in a clear acrylic (Lucite) block.

name: Element crystal
definition: sample of a refined chemical element sold as a grown crystal or crystal fragment for its identity.

name: Specimen display dome
definition: glass or acrylic dome with a base, made to cover and display one specimen.

name: Specimen stand
definition: stand or mount made to hold and display one specimen.

name: Single-specimen box
definition: box made to hold one specimen (such as a thumbnail box, if it holds one specimen; one holding several is B1).
